The instrument features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, housed within an elaborate gilded and painted wooden case with decorative carvings and statues. A large arched window is visible behind the central section of the organ. The surrounding architecture includes white stucco work and vaulted ceilings.
